Name: Nyapu Styled Clint Reforged portraits
Author: TastyHarakomeshi
Description:
This MOD replaces the original  portraits created by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/118355513]SoftPandaBoi[/url] for the Clint Reforged with portraits in Nyapu's art style.

This MOD supports all beard options from the original MOD: 'Half,' 'Full,' and 'None.'



Special thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/118355513]SoftPandaBoi[/url], the creator of Clint Reforged, for granting permission to use their work!
Thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/54606682]nyapu[/url] for creating the original Portrait art style!


Original Authors :  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/54606682]nyapu[/url]  (OG Portraits),   [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/118355513]SoftPandaBoi[/url]  (OG Mod Portraits).

Downloads.Description: This MOD is the type that directly overwrites the original MOD files.
